models.description: Smallest local Whisper model; fastest, lowest accuracy.
Default local Whisper model; balanced speed, size, and quality.
Higher quality local Whisper model with larger disk and CPU cost.
Largest v1 local Whisper option; best quality, highest resource use.
Local multilingual Parakeet TDT model executed with a Rust ONNX Runtime adapter. Highest memory use.
Memory-saving int8 Parakeet ONNX bundle. Smaller download and lower runtime weight memory; accuracy may differ from full precision.
On-device speaker diarization: a pure-Rust pyannote community-1 segmentation pipeline paired with WeSpeaker VoxCeleb ResNet34 embeddings, accelerated natively with Apple CoreML.
Default English tier: long-context (8192 tokens), Apache-2.0, 768-dimensional. The permissive license keeps the default path obligation-free.
Multilingual tier: covers 100+ languages, non-gated (MIT), 384-dimensional. A non-English user is guided here rather than silently degraded by the English default, and it serves English well too.
Custom multilingual option (BAAI/bge-m3), 1024-dimensional, 8192-token, CLS-pooled. Available via the Custom picker.
Custom English option (NovaSearch/stella_en_400M_v5), 2048-dimensional, MIT. Stronger English retrieval than the default Nomic; larger per-vector storage (2048-dim).

models.displayName: Snowflake Arctic Embed L v2.0 (Multilingual, Custom)
models.description: Custom multilingual option (Snowflake/snowflake-arctic-embed-l-v2.0), Matryoshka-truncated to 256-dimensional, Apache-2.0, CLS-pooled. bge-m3-class multilingual retrieval at a quarter of the per-vector storage.

Custom English option (Alibaba-NLP/gte-modernbert-base), 768-dimensional, Apache-2.0, CLS-pooled. Matches the default Nomic tier's retrieval quality on real capture data at roughly half the disk (~302 MB vs ~548 MB), but embeds slower AND — like every ModernBERT option here — uses more memory running than it does on disk (~596 MB resident against Nomic's ~273 MB, because candle cannot run ModernBERT in half precision). Pick it to save disk, not memory, speed or quality.

Custom English option (ibm-granite/granite-embedding-english-r2), 768-dimensional, Apache-2.0, CLS-pooled. Same ~302 MB footprint as GTE ModernBERT (and the same ~596 MB resident while running) and competitive on screen text, but measurably worse on audio transcripts — prefer GTE ModernBERT unless you index screen text only.

models.displayName: Granite Embedding Small English R2 (English, Custom)
models.description: Custom English option (ibm-granite/granite-embedding-small-english-r2), 384-dimensional, Apache-2.0, CLS-pooled. The low-disk, high-throughput end: ~99 MB on disk (~191 MB resident while running) and roughly 2.4× the indexing speed of the default, paying for it with clearly weaker retrieval — especially on audio transcripts.
